gui.aliyastoolkit.toolkit.title: Aliya's Toolkit Settings
gui.aliyastoolkit.hotbar_swap.descriptio: Press the key to switch the hotbar with a chosen inventory row in Specific Row mode, or cycle the three inventory rows and the hotbar in Cycle mode, without opening the inventory.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.exact_match.t: Automatic refill: when enabled, only items with identical data components (enchantments, name, ...) are refilled. Durability is ignored.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.chain_limit.t: Left click +1, right click -1; hold Shift for steps of 16
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.swap_row.tool: Only in Specific Row mode: the inventory row swapped with the hotbar. 1 = top row, 3 = bottom row (default); left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.swap_mode.too: Specific Row: swap the hotbar with the selected inventory row. Cycle: rotate all four rows in order.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.cycle_directi: Forward: inventory row 1 -> row 2 -> row 3 -> hotbar -> row 1. Reverse: the opposite order.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.preset.summar: Up %s, Down %s, Left %s, Right %s · Layers %s · Lock direction: %s
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.preset.add.to: Copy the current preset into a new one (max 16)
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.preset.delete: Delete the current preset (at least one must remain)
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.shape.up.tool: Blocks to extend upwards in the cross-section (0-4): left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.shape.down.to: Blocks to extend downwards in the cross-section (0-4): left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.shape.left.to: Blocks to extend left in the cross-section (0-4): left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.shape.right.t: Blocks to extend right in the cross-section (0-4): left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.length.toolti: Layers to extend forward (1-8): left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.lock_directio: ON: horizontally forward normally; while sneaking you can also go 45 degrees up/down. OFF: straight up/down is also possible normally, and all directions are available while sneaking.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.allow_other_b: ON: inside the massive-block shape, other breakable blocks are broken as well (unbreakable blocks and fluids are skipped). OFF: only blocks identical to the targeted block are broken.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.collect_fluid: ON: blueprint recording includes bucketable fluid sources and consumes empty buckets from your inventory; if there are not enough buckets you get a message and fluids are skipped.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.chain.preset_: Switch preset: hold %s and scroll; stops at both ends and never toggles chain mining.
gui.aliyastoolkit.build.operation.toolti:

gui.aliyastoolkit.build.dimension.toolti:

gui.aliyastoolkit.build.shape.tooltip:

gui.aliyastoolkit.build.fill.tooltip:
Options: %s
Left click = next, right click = previous (wrapping); available choices depend on dimension and shape
gui.aliyastoolkit.build.hint: Hold %s and scroll to switch presets; a target outline follows your crosshair before the first point. Right click twice to plan and build.
gui.aliyastoolkit.copy_paste.description: Record and build structures through a blueprint box.
gui.aliyastoolkit.copy_paste.hint.select: Press %s to enter. A target outline follows your crosshair before the first point. Right click to expand (light yellow), left click to shrink (light red); selection is light orange. Hold %s to snap to a block face.
gui.aliyastoolkit.copy_paste.hint.place: Draw: press %s to record and collect (cut), or %s to record only (copy). Build: right click pin, left click unpin, scroll distance, %s rotate.
gui.aliyastoolkit.copy_paste.hint.finish: Pinned: press %s to build. No items: %s switch mode, %s exit, %s open box.

message.aliyastoolkit.blueprint.only_box: Skipped %s blueprint box(es); no other blocks to record

aliyastoolkit.configuration.title: Aliya's Toolkit Configs
aliyastoolkit.configuration.enableHotbar: When enabled, the hotbar swap key swaps the hotbar with the selected inventory row.
aliyastoolkit.configuration.enableAutoRe: When enabled, whitelisted items that disappear from the hotbar are refilled from the inventory.
aliyastoolkit.configuration.enableChainM: When enabled, the chain mining key also breaks connected identical blocks.
aliyastoolkit.configuration.enableQuickB: When enabled, the quick build key lets you mark a region and build it with the block in your main hand.
aliyastoolkit.configuration.enableCopyPa: When enabled, holding a blueprint box lets you enter blueprint draw and build modes.
gui.aliyastoolkit.blueprint.clear.toolti: Return items to inventory and clear the blueprint; overflow drops at your feet
gui.aliyastoolkit.blueprint.take_all.too: Move items to inventory and keep the blueprint; overflow stays in the box
gui.aliyastoolkit.blueprint.store_all.to: Move matching items from inventory into the box
message.aliyastoolkit.blueprint.be_too_l: Block entity data too large to record the complete structure
